summary: The public closed callback factors internal _Core._initialize_endpoints_owned below the existing sealed-byte constructor path. _initialize_owned retains the exact token/sink/one-initialization guards, 40,960-byte sealed input validation, cut/fragment checks and the same two BytesIO objects, then delegates common endpoint/clock/owner/decoder initialization. The new helper retains token/exact maintained sink/one-initialization/cut/fragment guards and performs no endpoint I/O, discovery or diagnostic extraction. A fixed trusted composer must separately consume its original and validate exact owned endpoints, adapter, source and original identity; internal names/token are source conventions, not interpreter security or a public capability. Core __init__, _read, run and diagnostic algorithms remain unchanged. Inert public nonseekable endpoint controls exercise thirteen serialized exchanges, six exact slots, fragmented positive bounded reads, full write/flush/confirmation, no seek/EOF/fourteenth read, first/terminal output failures, read loss and a declared controlled aggregate-counter cut. Refused source status does not prove absence of a retained effect; originals stay consumed and cleanup Unknown. Existing two-role/three-purpose diagnostic reservations and four unsigned pre-expiry deliveries/two expiry refusals remain source semantics only, with no raw egress or operational ACK. Public prepare(profile) still always refuses before provider construction/effects, accepts no endpoint/provider/activation argument and imports no private provider. Only Core hash changes in the nine-file closed source manifest. The sixteen-role inert-slot-callback-pair/2 manifest/bundle/vector bytes, closed profile/schema/semantic digest, legacy codec and wire contracts remain unchanged; there is no /3 selection. Later coherent consumer adoption must independently select the same new protected producer revision for existing closed and slot pins, change the closed manifest digest and preserve unchanged slot/vector digests. This source preparation neither performs that adoption nor proves actual concurrent process/pipe/provider behavior, installed/native acceptance, persistence/enrollment/authenticated clocks, finite runtime containment or a complete physical-copy bound. ADR-0095 separately selects enforced resource containment for fresh profiles with production budgets/admission pending; original cap 65,536, physical bound null, fit unproved, admission false and original .103/.104/all 439 holds remain unchanged. Prior public /2 source history and its private-composer proof/receipt/observation obligations remain prerequisites; no operational or private authority acceptance follows.
title: Closed callback shares owned endpoint initialization without changing its engine or slot profile
